(375), $D^0_{\mu\nu}(\mathbf q,\omega)=\frac{4\pi c}{\omega^2}\frac{-q_\mu q_\nu+\frac{\omega^2}{c^2}\delta_{\mu\nu}}{q^2-\frac{\omega^2}{c^2}-i\eta}$. SI form of the width at $\Gamma$: $e^2Z^{*2}/(2\varepsilon_0\OS M_{\mathrm r}c\sqrt{\varepsilon_{\mathrm{env}}})$. The angular laws of the radiative widths of quantum-well excitons are those of Andreani, Tassone and Bassani (Solid State Commun. 77, 641, 1991). The width of 42 μeV and the shift of 21 μeV are our numbers for the hBN parameters of the table.
Symbols defined in this section
$\br_\parallel$, $z$; $r$; $q_z$
in-plane position and height above the sheet, which lies at $z=0$ (Å); $r=|\br_\parallel|$, an in-plane distance, in the Keldysh potential the distance between two charges (Å); a wavevector component normal to the sheet (Å⁻¹), in Section B.10 the normal wavevector of light emitted inside the light cone.
$\bQ_\parallel$, $Q_\parallel$, $\hat\bQ_\parallel$
in-plane wavevector of a wave in a sheet, its length and its direction (Å⁻¹); $\Gamma$ is $\bQ_\parallel=0$. EPP: $\mathbf Q=(Q_x,Q_y)$, $Q$.
$\mathbf K_\parallel$
in-plane wavevector of an electron state of the sheet (Å⁻¹). $\hat{\mathbf v}$: velocity operator, used for interband position matrix elements in . EPP: $\mathbf K=(K_x,K_y)$ in the surface Brillouin zone (SBZ).
$\OSSC$
area of the Born–von Kármán supercell of a sheet, $N_\ell\OS$: the whole sheet (Å²); sums over the states of a sheet carry $1/\OSSC$, as bulk sums carry $1/\OVSC$. EPP: $S$ (its cell area $S_{\rm uc}$ is our $\OS$).
$\rho^{\mathrm{2D}}$, $\rho_0$
charge per unit area of a sheet; amplitude of a charge wave $\rho^{\mathrm{2D}}=\rho_0\ee^{\ii\bQ_\parallel\cdot\br_\parallel}$ ($e$/Å²). In space, $\rho(\br)=\rho^{\mathrm{2D}}(\br_\parallel)\delta(z)$.
$v^{\mathrm{2D}}(Q_\parallel)$; $v(\bQ_\parallel;z,z')$
Coulomb interaction of a sheet, $2\pi e^2/Q_\parallel$, per unit area (eV Å²); the Coulomb energy of two charges $e$ at heights $z$ and $z'$, transformed along the plane, $(2\pi e^2/Q_\parallel)\ee^{-Q_\parallel|z-z'|}$, . EPP: $v_Q=2\pi/Q$, without $e^2$.
$\bP^{\mathrm{2D}}$; $\bE_\parallel$
sheet polarization, dipole moment per unit area ($e$/Å), ; in space $\bP=\bP^{\mathrm{2D}}\delta(z)$. $\bE_\parallel$: in-plane components of the electric field. $\bP^{\mathrm{2D}}_{\rme}$ and $E^{\ion}_\parallel$ in the screening steps: the electronic part of the polarization and the field of the ionic dipoles alone.
$d$
thickness of a layer, or the spacing of the layers in the parent bulk crystal (Å); 3.33 Å for hBN, 6.15 Å for MoS₂.
$\chi^{\mathrm{2D}}$
sheet polarizability: electronic dipole per area per unit in-plane field, a length in Gaussian units (Å), . Berkelbach et al.: $\chi_{2D}$; Cudazzo et al.: $\alpha_{2D}$.
$r_0$; $\varepsilon^{\mathrm{2D}}(\bQ_\parallel,\omega)$
screening length of the sheet, $r_0=2\pi\chi^{\mathrm{2D}}$ (Å); electronic dielectric function of the sheet (ions clamped), $1+r_0Q_\parallel$ when static and freestanding, , $\varepsilon_{\mathrm{env}}+r_0Q_\parallel$ in an environment, $1-v^{\mathrm{2D}}\chi^0$ in the RPA. EPP: $\epsilon^{\rm e}_{\rm 2D}(\mathbf Q,\omega)$.
$\varepsilon_{\mathrm{env}}$; $\varepsilon_{\mathrm{sub}}$, $\varepsilon_{\mathrm{cap}}$
dielectric constant of the environment of a sheet, the average of those of the substrate and the capping layer, ; 1 freestanding, about 2.5 on SiO₂, about 4.5 between hBN layers.
$W^{\mathrm{e,2D}}$; $W^{\rme}(\bQ_\parallel,\omega;z,z')$
screened interaction of a sheet, $v^{\mathrm{2D}}/\varepsilon^{\mathrm{2D}}$, an energy per unit area in $\bQ_\parallel$ space (eV Å²), ; as a function of the in-plane distance $r$ it is the Keldysh potential . $W^{\rme}(\bQ_\parallel,\omega;z,z')$: the RPA interaction between heights $z$ and $z'$, . EPP: $W^{\rm e,2D}(\mathbf Q,\omega)$ and $W^{\rm e}(\mathbf Q,\omega,z,z')$, without $e^2$.
$\nabla$, $\nabla'$; $\bj_\nu$
gradients acting on the two ends of a kernel after the in-plane transform, $(\ii Q_x,\ii Q_y,\partial_z)$ and $(-\ii Q_x,-\ii Q_y,\partial_{z'})$; $\bj_\nu$: the ionic current vertex $j_{\alpha\nu}$ of Section B.5 as a vector, with the basis phase.
$\omega_{\bQ_\parallel\nu}$, $\bar\omega_{\bQ_\parallel\nu}$
bare frequency of branch $\nu$ of the sheet, from the short-range force constants alone; frequency of the same mode dressed by its static screened dipole field, , as $\bar\omega_{\bq\nu}$ in bulk (Sections B.7 and B.9). In and $\omega$ is a pole of the phonon propagator found with the frequency kept in the interaction. EPP: $\omega_\sigma(\mathbf Q)$ and $\tilde\omega_\sigma(\mathbf Q)$.
$J_0$, $Y_0$, $\mathbf H_0$
Bessel functions of the first and second kind and Struve function, all of order zero; $\mathbf H_0$ is bold by convention, not a vector. They appear in the radial transform (box) and in the Keldysh potential .
$x$
in-plane distance between two charges in units of the crossover length, $x=\varepsilon_{\mathrm{env}}r/r_0$ (dimensionless), the argument of the Keldysh potential .
$m_{\mathrm X}$, $a_{\mathrm X}$, $E_{\mathrm b}$, $\psi_{\mathrm X}$
reduced mass of an electron–hole pair (in units of $m_{\mathrm e}$); exciton radius, the radius of the trial state $\ee^{-r/a_{\mathrm X}}$ at the minimum of the variational energy (Å); exciton binding energy (eV); envelope function of the relative motion, .
$\omega_{\mathrm p}^{\mathrm{2D}}(Q_\parallel)$, $n^{\mathrm{2D}}_{\mathrm c}$
plasma frequency of the carriers of a doped sheet: its square is $2\pi n^{\mathrm{2D}}_{\mathrm c}e^2Q_\parallel/m^*$, ; carrier density per area (cm⁻² or Å⁻²). $\delta\br_\parallel$: displacement of a carrier, $v_{\mathrm F}$: Fermi velocity.
$\zeta$
inverse decay length of the field away from the sheet, $\sqrt{Q_\parallel^2-\varepsilon_{\mathrm{env}}\omega^2/c^2}$ (Å⁻¹); $\zeta=-\ii q_z$ inside the light cone, –. v1 and the notes: $\beta$.
$\gamma^{\mathrm{rad}}_{\mathrm p}$, $\gamma^{\mathrm{rad}}_{\mathrm s}$
radiative linewidths (full width at half maximum) of the LO-like (p-polarized emission) and TO-like (s-polarized) in-plane modes, ; 42 μeV at $\Gamma$ for freestanding hBN.
